The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a anchor seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The lagoon receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. Bonded capital sits idle for 4 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
